name: NumberField
description:
A numeric input between − and + steppers, formatting its value (currency, percent, units…).

  NumberField(default_value: 1, min: 0, max: 10, name: "quantity", aria_label: "Quantity")
  NumberField(default_value: 19.99, step: 0.5, format: { style: "currency", currency: "USD" })

The visible input is a text field (role="spinbutton") showing the formatted value; a hidden input carries the plain number under `name:`. ↑/↓ step (Shift: `large_step`, 10× by default; Alt: `small_step`, a tenth), Home/End jump to the bounds, the steppers repeat while held and disable at a bound. The value is parsed and re-formatted when committed (blur, Enter, a step). Emits `appica-ui--number-field:change` with { value } (null when empty). Inside a Field it takes the field's id, name and state.
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes AppicaUI (e.g. `NumberField(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

examples.name: Usage
examples.code:
phlex do
  NumberField(variant:, size:, disabled:, step:, read_only:, required:, allow_wheel_scrub:, **given(value:, name:, invalid_number_message:, increment_label:, decrement_label:), default_value:, min:, max:, aria_label: "Quantity")
end

examples.name: Variants
examples.notes: The steppers invert their fill to stay legible on either variant.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex flex-wrap items-center gap-6") do
    NumberField(variant: :outline, default_value: 3, aria_label: "Outline quantity")
    NumberField(variant: :soft, default_value: 3, aria_label: "Soft quantity")
  end
end

examples.name: Sizes
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex flex-wrap items-center gap-6") do
    %i[ sm md lg ].each { |size| NumberField(size:, default_value: 3, aria_label: "#{size} quantity") }
  end
end

examples.name: Min, max & step
examples.notes: The steppers disable at a bound; ↑/↓ step, Shift ×10, Alt ×0.1.
examples.code:
phlex do
  Field(class: "w-fit") do
    FieldLabel(class: "mb-2") { "Rating (0-20, step 1)" }
    NumberField(default_value: 5, min: 0, max: 20, name: "rating")
  end
end

examples.name: Formatting
examples.notes: `format:` takes Intl.NumberFormat options (and `locale:`); the submitted value stays a plain number.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex flex-wrap items-end gap-6") do
    div(class: "flex flex-col gap-1.5") do
      label(for: "nf-price", class: "text-foreground-intense text-sm font-medium") { "Price" }
      NumberField(id: "nf-price", class: "w-40", default_value: 19.99, step: 0.5, format: { style: "currency", currency: "USD" }, locale: "en-US", name: "price")
    end
    div(class: "flex flex-col gap-1.5") do
      label(for: "nf-rate", class: "text-foreground-intense text-sm font-medium") { "Rate" }
      NumberField(id: "nf-rate", class: "w-32", default_value: 0.15, min: 0, max: 1, step: 0.01, format: { style: "percent" })
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Reacting to changes
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex flex-col items-center gap-3", data: { demo: "guests" }) do
    NumberField(default_value: 2, min: 0, aria_label: "Guests")
    p(class: "text-sm", data: { demo: "text" }) { "2 guests" }
  end
  script(type: "module") do
    raw safe(<<~JS)
      const demo = document.querySelector("[data-demo=guests]")
      demo.addEventListener("appica-ui--number-field:change", ({ detail: { value } }) => {
        const count = value ?? 0
        demo.querySelector("[data-demo=text]").textContent = `${count} ${count === 1 ? "guest" : "guests"}`
      })
    JS
  end
end

examples.name: Disabled & error states
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex flex-wrap items-center gap-6") do
    NumberField(variant: :soft, default_value: 3, disabled: true, aria_label: "Disabled quantity")
    NumberField(variant: :soft, default_value: 3, invalid: true, aria_label: "Quantity with error")
  end
end
